sloka: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रत्युवाच विनीतवत् ।स्नुषा ऽस्मि यदवोचस्त्वमेकपत्नीष्वयं क्रमः ।देवलोकस्थितिरियं सुराणां शाश्वती मता ।। ७.२६.४० ॥
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ pratyuvāca vinītavat ।snuṣā 'smi yadavocastvamekapatnīṣvayaṁ kramaḥ ।devalokasthitiriyaṁ surāṇāṁ śāśvatī matā ।। 7.26.40 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, Dashagriva replied as if humbly, saying that what she spoke about being a daughter-in-law and the custom of having one husband applies only to women with a single spouse, and that this custom of the divine world for gods is considered eternal.
